Messages.Author: Janne Hägglund
Messages.Body:
as...@hotmail.com writes:

> Can someone help me, or point me to some other way to view the newsgroup?
> ('Cept having it mailed too me off course)

Just Google for "newsreaders". Find one that works for your computer and
operating system, and has a user interface you like.

You may have to read the documentation or FAQ of your internet service
provider, to find out the address of their news server. There are free news
servers out there, but at least in my country the private news servers of the
local ISPs work better.

Once you have used a *proper* newsreader, you'll never go back to Google
Groups - except for searching, of course. (Google Groups exels in searching,
but sucks for reading news.)

Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
On Jan 24, 4:30 am, a...@hotmail.com wrote:
> After many attempts Google has finally made it: I can´t view threads
> in Google groups any more. What is wrong?

Weird. I'm on google.groups right now. The "beta" interface has mostly
removed the "threads" option (you can click on the title of the thread,
and you can read the messages in chronological order), but if you can
find the older, non beta interface (my work windows computer will only
use the beta interface; my home Mac will still use the non beta
interface), you can still get threaded messages.

> I click a topic and a new
> window open, where no thread is seen, just the first 10 messages.

Yeah, that is the beta interface. You might be able to get to the older
interface by clicking around some. I don't know why my home Mac still
goes to the older interface and my work Windows computer automatically
switched to the newer interface, and doesn't want to go to the older
interface page at all. It is a mystery.

> No
> link to take me to see the rest. Can someone help me, or point me to
> some other way to view the newsgroup? ('Cept having it mailed too me
> off course)

If you can't download a newsreader at work, you can configure your
Outlook if you have that to read usenet. You just need to find out what
your news-server is to configure it correctly. Maybe talk to your tech
guy who might be able to tell you. Pretend it is for some sort of
legitimate work related newsgroup use...

-Peter
